waitRetry: Wait a second and try again
tooLarge: The file is too large to save here
emptyText: Create a subject, such as “Calculus”, then add notebooks for lectures and seminars inside it.
subject: Subject
delSubjText: The subject “{s}” and {n} in it will be deleted with all their notes. This can’t be undone.
delNbText: The notebook “{t}” and all its pages will be deleted. This can’t be undone.
nbSizeHint: This size is locked to the first page. New pages with the lock always get it.
s_body:
This is a sample notebook. You can delete it from ⋯ under its cover on the shelf.
Write with the stylus. Scroll with one finger, zoom with two.
Tap the screen with two fingers to undo the last action.
Hold the stylus still at the end of a line to straighten it.
notBackup: This isn’t a KrisPekt backup file
restoreText: The backup has {s} and {n}. Notebooks already on the shelf will be replaced by the backup version. Everything else stays.
st1: All notebooks are stored only in this browser on this device. They are never uploaded.
st2: Your phone and tablet keep notebooks separately. To move them or keep a safe copy, save a backup and open it on the other device with “Restore from backup”.
st3: Always open KrisPekt the same way (for example, in Chrome from the same link). A different browser or cleared site data will show an empty shelf.
stWarn: The browser is blocking storage right now, so changes will be lost when you close the page.
storageBar: The browser is blocking storage, so your notes will be lost when you close the page. Open KrisPekt in Chrome in a normal (not incognito) window.
saveFail: Couldn’t save. Free up space on the device.
lockedSub: Same as the notebook’s first page: {size}. Tap to unlock.
unlockedSub: Now {size}. Tap to go back to the notebook size ({base}).
pdfBg: This page’s background is a PDF page.
keepOne: A notebook needs at least one page
delPageText: Page {n} will be deleted with all its notes. This can’t be undone.
colorAlready: This color is already on the toolbar
noRecent: Your custom colors will appear here
straighten: Straighten a line when the stylus is held still at the end
eraserHint: Tap the active eraser to switch between the pixel and the stroke eraser. Press and hold it to open these settings.
clearText: All notes, text and images on page {n} will be erased. You can bring them back with Undo.
textHint: Tap the page to type text. Tap existing text to edit it.
lassoHint: Circle notes to select them. Drag the selection to move it, or the circle in the corner to resize.
rulerHint: Ruler: drag with one finger, rotate with two. Draw along its edge with the stylus.
penFound: Stylus detected: write with the stylus, scroll with your finger. You can change this in the ⋯ menu
pdfModuleFail: The PDF module didn’t load. Check your connection and try again.
fingerOn: You can now write with your finger
fingerOff: Scroll with your finger, write with the stylus
pdfTooLong: The PDF has more than {n} pages, which is too many
badRecords: Some entries are damaged and were skipped
